Changelog Title: Enhanced direct debit statuses
Excerpt:
We’ve updated direct debit statuses to give you a clearer view of each step and when the last status change took place.

‍

‍
Description:
We’ve updated direct debit statuses to give you a clearer view of each step. The new statuses are:

  • No mandate: A mandate has not yet been sent to the customer, or the previous mandate was cancelled.
  • Awaiting signature: A mandate has been sent but is pending the customer’s signature.
  • Signed: The customer has signed the mandate with valid bank details, and we’re awaiting bank confirmation before we can submit a payment (usually 3 days).
  • Active: The mandate is confirmed and ready to collect payments.

For a quick overview of specific actions, hover over a status. For example, hovering over “Awaiting signature” will show the date you sent the mandate to the customer.

Changelog Title: Automatic invoice migration for Xero and QuickBooks
Excerpt:
‍

Switching to Adfin just got a whole lot easier. Now, when your customer signs a direct debit mandate with Adfin, we’ll automatically update your invoices in Xero or QuickBooks to use Adfin for payment.

‍

⚙️ How it works
  • Make sure invoice migration is enabled in your settings
  • Send direct debit mandates to your clients
  • Once a mandate is signed and active, we will:
    • Update the branding theme in Xero or the invoice terms in QuickBooks
    • Apply this to both standard and repeating invoices
    • Remove other payment providers from the invoice so there’s nothing you need to do
📬 After the switch
  • You’ll get an email notification when a customer has been migrated
  • We’ll also tag the customer in your dashboard so you can easily keep track

‍

No more manual updates. Just seamless payments through Adfin. ✅

‍

Changelog Title: Direct debits: say hello to recurring payments
Excerpt:
Direct debit payments are here! Send your customers a mandate to start collecting payments on autopilot.

‍
Description:
We're excited to introduce direct debit payments, making it easier to pay recurring and one-time invoices automatically.

Once a customer has signed a direct debit mandate (a 20-second process), we will take any future payment request you make via Adfin automatically without the customer needing to do a thing.


This unlocks more timely payments and further reduces the need for manual chasing and follow-ups. We will automatically chase any failed direct debit payment, including sending alternative payment options, at no additional cost or effort to you.

To get your customers set-up, head on to the Customers page, select the customers you'd like to invite and hit "send mandate". Once they complete the mandate form, you're ready to start collecting payments on autopilot. 💸

Changelog Title: Easier-to-read invoice statuses

You’ll now find “Sent” and “Seen” activities moved from invoice statuses to a new activities column, making it easier to follow the progress of each invoice. We’ve also added a new activity, “mandate pending signature”, which shows when an invoice is ready for direct debit collection but still needs the customer to sign their direct debit mandate.

  • The last time the payment link was opened
  • When an invoice was paid
  • If there is a pending mandate with the customer

‍

  • When the payment will be collected, including any retries that are happening
  • When the payment is expected to reach your bank

Changelog Title: More usability improvements
Excerpt: We've upgraded and added several new features to the Console.
Description:
• Cancel direct debit mandates: Click into the customer and select "Cancel Direct Debit" to cancel their mandate. If the mandate is pending signature, we'll automatically cancel any further reminders.
  • Customer search bar: Easily find and filter specific customers in the customer view.
  • Improved sorting: Sorting by status now automatically orders the records by activity date. For example, sorting by invoice status will place the most recently paid invoices at the top. We also remember your sorting preferences, so next time you open Adfin the tables will be as you left them.
  • Merge customers: Merging customers is now much more flexible, so it works for all scenarios. When you merge customers, we'll automatically cancel the mandate and Xero link associated with the archived customer.
  • Invoice upload: We’ve tweaked our invoice upload to make sure it doesn’t accept invalid documents that are not actually invoices - helping to minimise potential mistakes when dragging and dropping files into Adfin.

  • You can control surcharging at your account or customer level
  • Apple Pay and Google Pay will be disabled when you use surcharging
  • We collect the surcharge directly, so there’s no extra reconciliation for you ✨

👉 Head to Payments settings → Payments to turn on surcharging.

‍

‍

Good to know: fixed compensation is routed to Adfin. Statutory interest accrues to you.

Changelog Title: Cancel a direct debit mandate while payments are being collected
Excerpt:
‍

Sometimes a customer may ask you to cancel their direct debit mandate while a payment is already being collected.

‍

If the collection has already started, it cannot be cancelled. You can now queue the mandate to be cancelled automatically once the payment collection is complete.

‍

If the payment fails, we won’t retry the collection. We’ll simply cancel the mandate.

‍

👉 To do this, select the customer, open More options in the side tray, and click Cancel mandate.

Changelog Title: Bulk payments from customer statements
Excerpt:
Your customers can now pay multiple outstanding invoices and payment requests directly from their customer statement.

‍

When they receive a statement, they can choose which items they’d like to pay and make one payment for the selected total.

Changelog Title: Take phone payments for multiple invoices
Excerpt:
You can now take a single card payment over the phone for multiple outstanding invoices and payment requests.

‍

When you select a customer, you’ll be able to choose which items they want to pay, then complete the payment using the card details they provide.
